subject: Kickoff: progressive distillation for diffusion serving costs
body:
Jelena, team,

Kicking off the distillation track -- this is the efficiency portfolio's biggest single lever this half. Our image-generation serving cost is dominated by sampling steps, and progressive distillation attacks exactly that: distill a trained deterministic sampler into a student that needs half the steps, then repeat. The paper takes samplers from as many as 8192 steps down to 4 with modest quality loss -- FID 3.0 on CIFAR-10 at 4 steps -- and, crucially, the full distillation procedure costs no more than training the original model.

Target: our production image model from 256 steps to 8 or fewer, with quality signed off by the model owners. Milestones: recipe reproduced on CIFAR-10 by May 22, production-model distillation through June/July, LRB readout late July.

Jelena owns feasibility and the compute plan.

Zofia
